title.en: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay Polopina, Municipality of Concepcion, Province of Iloilo, To Be Known As the Polopina National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay Polopina, Municipality of Concepcion, Province of Iloilo, To Be Known As the Polopina National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Polopina, Thị trấn Concepcion, Tỉnh Iloilo được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Polopina
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Polopina, เทศบาล Concepcion, จังหวัด Iloilo ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Polopina
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Polopina, Kotamadya Concepcion, Provinsi Iloilo dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Polopina
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Polopina, Perbandaran Concepcion, Wilayah Iloilo dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Polopina

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in Barangay Polopina, Municipality of Concepcion, Province of Iloilo, to be known as the Polopina National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
